clips.title: The story
paras: In Goldshire, William Pestle packs candles from Elwynn's kobolds for his brother Morgan in Stormwind.

William Pestle keeps trade moving between Goldshire and the capital. He gathers materials in Elwynn Forest, while his brother Morgan runs Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind's Trade District. William cannot leave his duties to travel north, so he depends on couriers to carry the parcel of wax and candles into the city.

Kobold candles from Elwynn's mines fill the shipment. William gathers the large candles for their wax and packs them for Morgan at Pestle's Apothecary. The wax joins the stock used in the capital's alchemical trade.
